decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reason for approval: It is considered that provided the use relates solely to the occupation of No.4 Bath Road for residential purposes by Shepherds Bush Housing Association, the development complies with the Council's U.D.P. policy H.3.1, will not be harmful to local residential ameity, and will preserve and enhance Bedford Park Conservation Area.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The office and training room hereby permitted shall not be used for purposes other than relating to the occupation of No. 4 Bath Road for residential accommodation by Shepherd's Bush Housing Association.
Condition : 4 - Informative: Listed Building Consent will be required for any alterations to the fabric of the building (e.g. handrails, insulation, etc.)
description: Change of use of wardens flat to office and training room
